answers.core: Importing gltf files is already in core. This is only an additional feature.
answers.workaround: At the moment everything can also be achieved, just a lot less convenient. You need to export for every instanced object the mesh as an `.obj` file, and then set up the `MultiMeshInstance` node manually, and inputting all the transforms for the different instances manually. (In case you don't want to use code, which also doesn't make everything simpler). Also this would make preparing the assets for importing in 3d modeling software much easier, as everything will "just work".
